pages.text: $(italic)Automation/crafting investment. Best for Artificer. Unique in the pack — 0% of effects are attribute-based. 100% are command-driven via KubeJS scoreboard hooks.$(/italic)$(br2)$(warn)Engineering tree effects are KubeJS-dependent (Phase 2).$(end) $(note)The skill points are spendable and nodes are visible, but the underlying bonuses activate when the KubeJS bridge is implemented. Your points will not be wasted — they will activate retroactively.$(end)

pages.title: Nodes
pages.text: $(bold)Crafting Speed$(/bold) — Reduces crafting time in automated crafters (Create, RS, IF). Manual crafting is always instant.$(br2)$(bold)Machine Efficiency$(/bold) — +% machine processing speed. Applies to Thermal, IF, Mekanism machines.$(br2)$(bold)RF Generation$(/bold) — +% RF output from all generators. Scales to +25% at max investment.

pages.title: Nodes (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Resource Doubling Branch$(/bold) — +% chance for ore processing to yield an extra ingot.$(br2)$(bold)Blueprint Memory Branch$(/bold) — Reduces anvil repair costs, XP enchanting costs, and Patchouli book recipe unlock costs.$(br2)$(bold)Engineering Capstone$(/bold) — $(bold)Master Engineer$(/bold) — All machines in 16-block radius run at +50% speed for 60s every 5 min. Passive pulse.
